LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_WandererText: {0} is in this space. Nobody brought them in and they offer no account of themselves. They are not hostile.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_MissingText: {0} is here. Whoever they were, they went missing, and this is where they ended up. They are not hostile.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_SurvivorText: {0} is alive down here and wants out. They will leave with anyone who can carry them through a gate.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_PsychoticLabel: Something is here, and it is not friendly
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_PsychoticText: {0} has been in this space far too long. They will not be reasoned with, and they will defend where they are standing. They will not follow you out of the space if you withdraw.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_PackLabel: Several of them, and they move together
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_PackText: {0} is not alone. They have been down here long enough to act as a group. They hold their ground rather than hunting, but there is more than one.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PawnLostInside: {0} was lost inside a coordinate. The Backrooms remembers people it keeps.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_EchoText: {0} is standing in this space, wearing what they were wearing this morning. {0} is also at home right now. Whatever this is, it is not hostile, and it is not them.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_WandererTell: There is no dust on them. Nothing in this space has been swept.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_MissingTell: Their clothes are in better repair than the day they went missing.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_SurvivorTell: They have been counting the days. The number they give is wrong, and not by a little.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_PsychoticTell: They are standing on the spot where the last crew's recorder stopped.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_PackTell: They are standing in a ring, facing outward. The floor is worn where they have been standing.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_EchoTell: Wearing what the real one put on this morning, down to the repairs.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_DeadRecentTell: The file gives a cause of death that has not happened to them yet.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_DeadStrippedTell: Stripped tidily. Their gear was stacked beside them, not taken.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_DeadCrewTell: They are lying in a circle, facing in. Nobody moved them afterwards.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_HelperTell: They used the branch's name before anybody said it, and they will not go near the threshold.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_FaunaDomesticTell: Well fed. There is nothing to eat in this space and nothing to drink.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_FaunaWildTell: It is not thin, it is not frightened, and there is no way in here that it could have used.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_HelperText: {0} is in this space and has taken the crew's side. They will stand with the team against what else is down here. They will not leave with them, and they do not explain why.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_FaunaDomesticText: {0} is in this space. It was somebody's animal and it is in good condition. Something brought it in here.
LanguageData.RR_Inhabitant_FaunaWildText: {0} is in this space, a long way from anywhere it could have walked in from. It is not thin and it is not frightened.
